scope: Deterministic normal-rule AI content and starvation-regression comparison; not native GUI, full I-V acceptance for every civilization, multi-map testing or statistical balance
method: Each raw event file was read and SHA-256 checked against case receipt; natural end/no resignation/zero loser survivors independently reconstructed. Paid unit completions use Unit trained XP events emitted directly after each production Spawn; shipment and age-reward spawns are excluded. Worker maxima are reconstructed from Spawn and Death. Repair event counts are 0.1s payment ticks, not independent repair sessions. Gross trade coin uses actual credited transaction deltas, not cross-resource profit. rawEventsSha256 identifies the uncompressed JSONL bytes; archived event paths end in .gz and must be decompressed before checking this value.

culverinCoverage.limitation: The normal AI matrix contains culverin reward arrivals but no paid workshop culverin queue or completion. Separate mechanics tests verify paid staffed culverin production; these evidence scopes must not be conflated.

limitations: Fixed authored map, seed 314159, Standard AI, max age V, one run of each ordered pair; mirrored cases have different player slot/deck presets.
Age cap V does not mean both players reached V. Reported distributions preserve II/III/IV endings.
Shield log proves command use; protection timing and damage-type behavior are covered separately by unit tests, not inferred from stance counts.
A cargo-loss event can come from combat or endpoint loss; it is not automatically a budget cancellation.
A win/loss change in these deterministic examples is not an estimate of civilization balance.
Pilot cases duplicate the corresponding pre-fix matrix logs when their SHA-256 matches and are not counted as extra independent games.
Zero paid culverin production in the normal AI matrix is retained as a coverage gap; 18 culverin spawns do not prove paid workshop manufacture.
